post.description:
Ask ProfitLens a natural-language
business question.

D2C deterministic analytics own all
numerical business truth.

AI is used only for interpretation.

Run a deterministic ProfitLens sensitivity
scenario.

Scenario calculations are performed by the
deterministic scenario engine.

Execute an internal deterministic analysis plan.

Intended for:
- debugging
- auditability
- development
- future analyst/admin tooling

This endpoint is not used by the
production ProfitLens frontend.

AnalyticsContext.title: AnalyticsContext
AnalyticsContext.description:
Shared ProfitLens analytics context.

This becomes the common contract used by:
- dashboards
- charts
- tables
- AI Analyst
- investigations
- Scenario Lab
- exports

Existing month-based endpoints can continue operating
during the migration.

ScenarioChanges.title: ScenarioChanges
ScenarioChanges.description:
Structured Scenario Lab controls.

Percent fields represent relative changes unless
otherwise stated.

Examples:
    orders_change_percent = 10
        -> orders increase by 10%

    marketing_spend_change_percent = -10
        -> marketing spend decreases by 10%

    rto_reduction_percent = 20
        -> RTO volume/rate reduced by 20%
